284475948.description:
Ornate Smoking Pipe with Filigree Detail
Carved Material and Silver-Tone Metal Smoking Pipe
Middle Eastern / Balkan Folk Art Style, 20th Century
This vintage smoking pipe features an intricately carved dark bowl coupled with an elongated silver-tone metal stem adorned with filigree wirework scrolls and zig-zag banding. The stem includes an attached fold-down spiral wire kickstand to support the pipe when resting, as well as an attached chain holding a matching domed filigree wind cap. The upper stem curves gracefully toward the flared mouthpiece, highlighted by ribbed coiled wire accents reflecting traditional artisanal craftsmanship.
Silver-tone metal stem with applied filigree wire scrollwork and zig-zag banded collars
Dark carved bowl featuring incised geometric motifs and ribbed detailing
Attached link chain with matching circular domed filigree cap / cover
Integrated dual-spiral wire rest/kickstand for tabletop placement
Dimensions: 10 inches long by 2 inches wide by 1 inch high
Condition:
Vintage condition with age-appropriate wear. Metalwork exhibits natural surface tarnish, patina, and light handling marks consistent with age. Carved bowl shows interior residue, surface dust, and wear within carved recesses. Chain, decorative cap, and wire rest remain attached. No maker marks or metal purity hallmarks detected.
